name: motely-node
description: MotelyJAML for Node.js - Balatro seed analyzer and JAML filter engine using a native .node addon

scripts.build: npm run generate:jaml-schema && node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js && .\node_modules\@esbuild\win32-x64\esbuild.exe index.js --outfile=index.cjs --format=cjs --platform=node --banner:js="const import_meta_url=require('url').pathToFileURL(__filename).href;" --define:import.meta.url=import_meta_url && .\node_modules\@esbuild\win32-x64\esbuild.exe server.js --outfile=server.cjs --format=cjs --platform=node --banner:js="const import_meta_url=require('url').pathToFileURL(__filename).href;" --define:import.meta.url=import_meta_url
scripts.pack:local: npm run build && npm run stage-framework && npm pack --json --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepack: dotnet publish ../Motely.NodeAddon/Motely.NodeAddon.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 && npm run build && npm run stage-framework
